title: Karbuja (Musk Melon): modeled ₹650/qtl left, Kangra (Baijnath) → Una
summary: April 2024: reported karbuja (Musk Melon) prices at Kangra (Baijnath) and Una imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 80% of 15 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹650 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 50 same-variety market pairs screened for karbuja (Musk Melon) in April 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Karbhuja, Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Una report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: April 2024
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) and Una (Himachal Pradesh) both reported karbuja (Musk Melon) prices for the same variety and grade (Karbhuja, Medium) on 15 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹4,000 per quintal. Una reported a median ₹5,000 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,200/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,200 per quintal, and Una was dearer on 80% of days.

scenes.headline: 93 km by road
scenes.caption: 93 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹20/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹720 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹440 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Una report, the rule selects 9 of 15 modeled shipping days. 8 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹650 per quintal (₹396 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Karbuja (Musk Melon) route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Una was positive on 80% of matched days in April 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹65,000, or ₹39,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to karbuja (Musk Melon)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹20/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Karbuja (Musk Melon) route from Kangra (Baijnath) to Una was positive on 80% of matched days in April 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹65,000, or ₹39,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
RBI Working Paper WPS (DEPR) 08/2024 — Price Dynamics of Tomato, Onion and Potato
